what: Measurements of the RTL simulation (Icarus Verilog) of the self-checking testbenches in tb/; nothing here comes from the Python models
simulator: Icarus Verilog, apt package of the ubuntu-latest runner (version not printed in the log)

files.rtl_trace_fft512.csv: tb_fft512_mem, chunk 0: signals sampled at the rising edge, cycle 0 = start high
files.rtl_trace_squarer.csv: tb_mag_sq_odd, directed examples (3, -5), (0, 0), (-4, 2): cycle 0 = start high
files.rtl_state_occupancy.csv: tb_psd_top (WL = 12, 4 chunks, 3 segments, one clear) and tb_bispectrum_top (WL = 12, 5 frames, one clear), cycles per state from reset release to the last result
files.rtl_squarer_wait_hist.csv: tb_psd_top, bins by floor(log2(cycles in W_S)) per visit
